idea-plugin.name: Dual Terminal Windows
idea-plugin.description:
Adds two independent terminal tool windows for developers who want simultaneous shells in different parts of the IDE.

Terminal A and Terminal B can each be docked, resized, floated, and moved separately. Every shell starts in the project root and uses the IDE's configured terminal shell.

This beta targets RustRover 2026.2 and uses the bundled Classic terminal implementation.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Adds two independently movable terminal tool windows.
  • Starts each shell in the current project root.
  • Remembers tool-window placement through the IDE layout system.
